p.src: 1  But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

en: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
u.src: 1  But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

p.src: 2  that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

en: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
u.src: 2  that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

p.src: 3  and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

en: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
u.src: 3  and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

p.src: 4  that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

en: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
u.src: 4  that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

p.src: 5  to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

en: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
u.src: 5  to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

p.src: 6  Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

en: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
u.src: 6  Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

p.src: 7  In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

en: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
u.src: 7  In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

p.src: 8  and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

en: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
u.src: 8  and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

p.src: 9  Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

en: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
u.src: 9  Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

p.src: 10  not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

en: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
u.src: 10  not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

p.src: 11  For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

en: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
u.src: 11  For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

p.src: 12  instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

en: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
u.src: 12  instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

p.src: 13  looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

en: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
u.src: 13  looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

p.src: 14  who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

en: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
u.src: 14  who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

p.src: 15  Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

en: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
